step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a cross-coupled transistor pair with resistive and capacitive loads. It acts as the regenerative latching stage in a high-speed comparator, using positive feedback to amplify a small initial voltage difference into a full logic-level swing.

regeneration_time.description: Time required for the latch to amplify a small initial voltage difference (e.g., 10mV) to a large signal difference (e.g., 800mV).

sky130_expected.calculation: Time constant tau = C_load / gm. For W=5u, L=0.15u NMOS at 0.5mA, gm ~= 3mS. With C_load=10fF, tau ~= 3.3ps. Time to grow from 10mV to 800mV is tau * ln(80) ~= 14.5ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the load capacitance and the gm of the cross-coupled pair. SKY130 130nm CMOS is slower than 55-GHz SiGe HBT, but for very small loads (10fF), regeneration can still be in the 10-20ps range.

power_consumption.description: Static power dissipation of the latch stage.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The latch itself consumes a fraction of the total comparator power. It is strictly set by the tail current source and VDD.

voltage_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing at the output nodes.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly listed, typically 200mV - 1V for CML/ECL.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the tail current and load resistors to ensure sufficient logic levels without driving transistors into deep triode/saturation.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the regeneration time, voltage swing, and power consumption of the cross-coupled latch. An initial small voltage difference is applied to the outputs to trigger the positive feedback.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Cross-coupled latch testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* Parameters
.param W_m1=5u L_m1=0.15u
.param R_load=1k C_load=10f I_tail=1m

* Supply and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
Ibias N2 0 {I_tail}

* DUT (Adapted from NPN to SKY130 CMOS for compatibility)
M1 Vout Vout_bar N2 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_m1} l={L_m1}
M2 Vout_bar Vout N2 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_m1} l={L_m1}
CL1 VDD Vout_bar {C_load}
CL2 VDD Vout {C_load}
RL1 VDD Vout {R_load}
RL2 VDD Vout_bar {R_load}

* Initial conditions to trigger regeneration (2mV initial difference)
.ic v(Vout)=1.299 v(Vout_bar)=1.301 v(N2)=0.5

.control
  * Run transient analysis
  tran 1p 200p uic
  
  * 1. Power Consumption
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  meas tran avg_power avg power
  
  * 2. Voltage Swing
  meas tran vout_max max v(Vout_bar)
  meas tran vout_min min v(Vout_bar)
  let swing = vout_max - vout_min
  print swing
  
  * 3. Regeneration Time (Time to grow from 10mV to 800mV difference)
  let vdiff = v(Vout_bar) - v(Vout)
  meas tran regen_time trig vdiff val=0.01 rise=1 targ vdiff val=0.8 rise=1
  
  quit
.endc
.end
